criteria.statement: Kind 31953 is parameterized replaceable, policy-readable, trusted-author checked, and validates its schema/top-level allowlist.
Provisioning carries the pinned fleet snapshot to runtime params.
OpenClaw renders fleet template then agent overrides then wrapper-owned identity, Nostr, bindings, plugins, and file secret refs; fleet defaults override environment fallbacks.
Web operators can edit, sign, publish, and observe relay acceptance for the fleet document.
